title: DynaDebate: Breaking Homogeneity in Multi-Agent Debate with Dynamic Path Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the diversity of reasoning paths generated by multiple agents using intra-diversity (average pairwise cosine distance of TF-IDF representations) and structural non-overlap metrics (Jaccard overlap of step-level reasoning units).

Evaluating the susceptibility of agents to "blind conformity" (abandoning correct original reasoning to align with an erroneous group consensus) during multi-agent debates across mathematical and factual benchmarks.
